site.name: First Trusted Square / Shackleton Rim rehearsal tile
site.purpose: Software proof slice for lunar terrain, uncertainty, and robot traverse reasoning.

datasets.title: LOLA Shackleton Rim DEM byte-range fixture
datasets.citation: LRO LOLA GDR product ldem_875s_20m_float, extracted from official PDS Geosciences byte ranges for Moonmoon software proof.
notes: Elevation values are measured LOLA DEM samples converted from kilometers to meters relative to the 1737.4 km reference radius.
The raw 230 MB IMG is not committed; the tiny CSV is reproducibly extracted from HTTP byte ranges.
Do not use this dataset for mission-grade traverse planning without independent geospatial review.

datasets.title: LOLA west-contour route-window DEM byte-range fixture
datasets.citation: LRO LOLA GDR product ldem_875s_20m_float, west-adjacent byte-range extraction for Moonmoon route evidence.
notes: This is measured local terrain evidence for a route alternative, not proof that the route is safe.
The adjacent window remains a tiny software-proof sample and must be expanded before robot planning.

datasets.title: LOLA north-rim route-window DEM byte-range fixture
datasets.citation: LRO LOLA GDR product ldem_875s_20m_float, north-adjacent byte-range extraction for Moonmoon route evidence.
notes: This is measured local terrain evidence for a route alternative, not proof that the route is safe.
Illumination and a wider corridor search are still required before robot planning.

datasets.title: LOLA southwest-bypass corridor DEM byte-range fixture

The window is the best sampled local grade among the first 5x5 scan but remains blocked by conservative rover limits.

datasets.title: LOLA south-stepout corridor DEM byte-range fixture
datasets.citation: LRO LOLA GDR product ldem_875s_20m_float, south widened corridor byte-range extraction for Moonmoon route evidence.
notes: This is measured local terrain evidence from the first widened corridor scan, not proof that the route is safe.

datasets.title: LOLA northeast-stepout 9x9 corridor DEM byte-range fixture
datasets.citation: LRO LOLA GDR product ldem_875s_20m_float, northeast 9x9 corridor byte-range extraction for Moonmoon route evidence.

source_candidates.title: LRO LOLA derived gridded topography candidate
source_candidates.intended_use: Replace the synthetic trusted-square DEM with a tiny authoritative lunar south-pole terrain extraction.
source_candidates.next_action: Use the checked LOLA byte-range fixtures for software proof, then add illumination and wider corridor search before any rover claim.
notes: PDS Geosciences identifies LOLA as the LRO Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter for high-resolution lunar topography.
The PDS page lists derived GDR and SLDEM product families and points recent LOLA data discovery to ODE/LOLA Data Node.
The first trusted-square active fixture now uses a checked LOLA GDR byte-range extraction for software proof.

source_candidates.title: Lunar solar ephemeris power-window candidate
source_candidates.product_family: Sun/Moon ephemeris and lunar orientation kernels
source_candidates.intended_use: Attach time-windowed Sun/Moon geometry, local sunlit hours, and rover power-window evidence to the first trusted square.
source_candidates.next_action: Review the computed low-sun-angle power window, local horizon assumptions, and rover power model before clearing the energy gate.
notes: The current illumination and energy gates deliberately block because computed power remains below the conservative route demand.
The NAIF source files and first time-bounded Sun/Moon geometry computation are pinned locally.
This candidate turns the ephemeris evidence from prose into a typed MoonBook-visible source contract.

source_acquisition_plans.expected_format: PDS LOLA GDR south-polar gridded elevation product selected through ODE/PDS metadata
source_acquisition_plans.trust_gate: The active software-proof fixtures must keep product family URL, metadata URL, selected product URL, SHA-256, extraction windows, and generated CSV checksums recorded.

steps.title: Confirm product family
steps.action: Use the PDS LOLA page and Lunar ODE to confirm the south-polar GDR float product is the right first authoritative terrain source.
steps.expected_evidence: Official PDS page URL, ODE discovery URL, GDR family URL, and GDR catalog URL.
steps.done_when: The source candidate points to a named product family and the acquisition plan names a reachable PDS family root.

steps.title: Fetch metadata first
steps.action: Download the GDR catalog before any large image and record the selected product route, projection assumptions, units, byte order, and map scale.
steps.expected_evidence: A local GDR catalog file with SHA-256 recorded in the authoritative dataset manifest draft.
steps.done_when: The extractor can derive pixel coordinates for the trusted-square bounds without reading the full image into memory.

steps.title: Extract tiny tile
steps.action: Read only the needed south-pole window from the float image and emit a compact CSV for the first trusted square.
steps.expected_evidence: A small CSV under data/sources/lro_lola with source product id, bounds, resolution, and SHA-256.
steps.done_when: scripts/generate_moonmoon_fixture.py regenerates MoonBit terrain from the authoritative CSV.

steps.title: Verify evidence chain
steps.action: Check raw label checksum, raw image checksum when available, extracted CSV checksum, and generated inline grid fingerprint.
steps.expected_evidence: A passing source verification script and a DatasetValidation with status verified.
steps.done_when: moon test passes while the dossier marks the authoritative dataset as accepted for software proof.

steps.title: Human review before mission claims
steps.action: Review projection math, elevation units, polar singularity handling, and traverse thresholds before raising claim kind beyond derived software evidence.
steps.expected_evidence: MoonBook review notes tied to the dataset, terrain metrics, and traverse decision.
steps.done_when: The source-upgrade blocker is closed and remaining review focuses on terrain hazards, illumination, and route alternatives.

source_acquisition_plans.target_region: First Trusted Square near Shackleton rim, 89.88S, 0.12E
source_acquisition_plans.expected_format: Pinned ephemeris/orientation source plus generated JSON power-window evidence
source_acquisition_plans.trust_gate: Computed from cited NAIF ephemeris/orientation sources with pinned checksums; local horizon and rover power assumptions still require review before energy can move out of block.

steps.title: Select official ephemeris source
steps.action: Choose NAIF SPICE kernels or an equivalent official illumination product that can support Sun/Moon geometry for the south-pole tile.
steps.expected_evidence: Source family URL, kernel/product names, access URL, and license/usage notes recorded in MoonBook.
steps.done_when: done: the candidate names concrete official NAIF source files instead of a generic power assumption.

steps.title: Pin checksummed inputs
steps.action: Record exact kernel or illumination product files, byte counts, SHA-256 checksums, and local paths under data/sources/lunar_ephemeris.
steps.expected_evidence: A README plus source metadata checksum fields that make reruns deterministic.
steps.done_when: done: scripts/verify_moonmoon_sources.sh rejects missing or changed ephemeris inputs.

steps.title: Compute local power window
steps.action: Evaluate the first trusted square over a declared time span and emit sunlit hours, dark survival hours, incidence notes, and confidence.
steps.done_when: done: the JSON records time range, source checksums, local coordinate, sunlit hours, dark hours, and uncertainty.

steps.title: Generate MoonBit evidence
steps.action: Mirror the checked JSON into src/mission/generated_first_trusted_square_power_window.mbt for deterministic mission tests.
steps.expected_evidence: Generated MoonBit power-window module and tests tied to the JSON checksum.
steps.done_when: done: moon test proves the mission energy gate reads generated ephemeris evidence instead of hard-coded zero Wh.

steps.title: Review before unblocking Moonrobo
steps.action: Have MoonBook record reviewer acceptance that the ephemeris source, local horizon assumptions, and rover power model are coherent.
steps.expected_evidence: A review transition moving the ephemeris source candidate and energy-window item out of needs-evidence.
steps.done_when: Moonrobo handoff remains blocked or becomes reviewable based on measured terrain plus accepted time-windowed power evidence.

source_product_selections.selection_reason: Covers the first trusted square near 89.88S with south-polar 20 m/pixel LOLA DEM data and has a small pinned XML label for extractor development.
source_product_selections.extraction_risk: The image is about 230 MB and should be window-read from the float raster after projection math is tested; do not commit the raw image.
